cards.title: Read the {{ s.condo.m.medianPrice.pct | signed }} condo median with care.
cards.body: The condo/townhome median rose to {{ s.condo.m.medianPrice.current | usd }} from {{ s.condo.m.medianPrice.prior | usd }}, but it rests on only {{ s.condo.m.closedSales.current | int }} closings. A small sample can shift with the mix of units that happened to sell, so it is not a blanket conclusion about what any condo or townhome is worth.

insights.localLine: County figures blend distinct local markets, including Stuart, Palm City, Jensen Beach, Hobe Sound and Port Salerno, and conditions in any one of them can differ from the county median.
